query:
SELECT email, MIN(name) as name, MIN(kidName) as kidName, reason FROM (
  SELECT l.email, l.parentName as name, l.kidName, 'Already received nurture emails' as reason
  FROM leads l
  INNER JOIN leadSequenceQueue lsq ON lsq.leadId = l.id
  WHERE lsq.sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
    AND lsq.status = 'sent'
    AND l.email IS NOT NULL AND l.email != ''
) combined
GROUP BY email, reason
ORDER BY name
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 6;
